jobs.title: Junior Software Developer
jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY

PK is currently looking for a creative, self\-starting, Junior Software Engineer who is ready to develop new products with passion and precision.

You will design and implement new features in PK’s software projects: Loudspeaker remote control application (.dynamics), mobile applications, and internal PK software tools to aid in development and manufacturing. You will also participate in shaping the future of the software department at PK Sound, helping make long\-term technology choices to improve and scale the software. Working with customers across the globe on some of the highest\-profile events and venues, what you create will have a significant impact not only for the company but the millions of people who enjoy experiencing our loudspeakers.

ABOUT PK SOUND

PK Sound is an owner\-operated, advanced loudspeaker manufacturer, proudly headquartered in Calgary, Alberta Canada, servicing the world. We pride ourselves on being a fresh alternative to the status quo, providing creative and innovative solutions in an ever\-evolving marketplace. It is one thing to hear music, it is another to experience it. PK Sound was born out of the marriage of acoustic engineering and human emotion, in facilitation of the connection between artist and fan. We measure performance as much in the reaction of a devoted fan as in the read\-out of a lab instrument. In all we do, wherever the PK logo appears, there can be no compromise, and no end in our desire to achieve new standards of performance, better ways of collaboration, and new avenues of innovation to advance industry technology for all.

There is no doubt we work hard, but we share in the success, and we have a lot of fun doing it. If you are looking for a company with an amazing brand, industry\-changing technology, an exceptional workplace environment, and that is poised to aggressively grow on the global market, this job is for you!

BENEFITS OF WORKING AT PK SOUND

* Employee ownership equity program
* Competitive wages
* Working with cutting\-edge technology
* Travel opportunities for in the field testing
* Fun work environment
* Attractive benefits
* Free Parking
* Company excursions
* On\-site gym

PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

* Develop and maintain new and existing software products and infrastructure.
* Analyze, design, and develop tests and test\-automation suites.
* Participate in all phases of the product development lifecycle.
* Integrate electronic hardware, firmware, and software into complete systems.
* Ensure reliable operation of products under extreme conditions.
* Communicate progress and problems to management and other departments.
* Create product documentation and user manuals.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with business users, project managers, and other engineers.
* Provide recommendations for continuous improvement.
* Travel to concert venues and festivals may be required for technical support or software testing.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

* HTML \& CSS, JavaScript with modern frameworks.
* Asynchronous programming.
* Good understanding of software design principles (e.g. SOLID, modularity, testability etc).
* Experience with AI coding tools
* Test\-driven development, mocking, assertion libraries.
* Desktop application development understanding.
* Meticulous attention to detail.
* Critical and pragmatic thinking.
* A collaborative approach to problem\-solving.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Bachelor’s Degree in engineering, computer science, or equivalent experience.
* Minimum of 1 year of experience in a professional or co\-op software development position or an equivalent personal project portfolio.

PREFERENCE WILL BE GIVEN TO CANDIDATES WITH

* C\#, .NET, ASP.NET Core RESTful services, and API development
* Web development experience with Angular.
* Cross\-platform desktop application development with Electron.
* Experience developing with Flutter.
* Reactive programming with ReactiveX.
* Experience using the Cypress and/or Jest test frameworks.
* Experience working with DevOps infrastructure such as Microsoft Azure DevOps.
* Experience developing in both MAC and Windows OS environments.
* Agile product development lifecycle experience (Kanban, Scrum).
* Network programming (experience with UDP/TCP coding, protocol creation/development).
* Experience integrating software with Embedded devices.
* Knowledge of professional audio industry.

OTHER REQUIREMENTS

* A valid passport, with the ability to travel without restriction.

Work Remotely

* No

Job Types: Permanent, Full\-time

Pay: From $65,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Company events
* Dental care
* Employee stock purchase plan
* Extended health care
* On\-site gym
* On\-site parking
* Paid time off
* Vision care

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Calgary, AB: reliably commute or plan to relocate before starting work (preferred)

Application question(s):

* Tell us why you are interested in working for PK Sound?

Education:

* Bachelor's Degree (preferred)

Experience:

* Software development: 1 year (required)
* JavaScript: 1 year (preferred)
* Python: 1 year (preferred)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Athennian**


Athennian delivers Governance Ops™ software that aligns legal, finance, tax and fund teams through a secure, integrated source of truth for entity and ownership data. The platform enables organizations managing complex corporate and investment structures to automate governance workflows, maintain audit\-ready records and collaborate across functions with confidence.  

  

More than 500,000 entities across over 150 countries are managed on Athennian, helping organizations modernize entity management and transform governance operations into a strategic advantage.  

  

We are a fast\-moving, solutions\-driven team using an AI\-forward approach to solve complex operational challenges. If you are passionate about building technology that transforms traditional industries, we’d love to have you join us.

 **About the role**


We're looking for a driven **Software Engineer** to join our dynamic engineering team to contribute to our mission of managing hundreds of thousands of business entities worldwide, empowering our users with a platform that inspires trust. In this role, you will contribute to designing, building, and maintaining scalable software solutions that enhance our platform's functionality and performance. Reporting to the Sr Engineering Manager, you will collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality full\-stack solutions, while leading the integration and operation of production AI features (such as RAG, intelligent search, LLM integrations, or agents).

 **What you'll do**

* **Architect \& Deliver:** Develop, test, and deploy high\-quality, scalable software solutions that align with complex business needs.
* **Strategic System Design:** Participate in technical discussions and contribute to high\-level decisions on system architecture, focusing on configurability and long\-term maintainability.
* **Ship Production AI Features:** Lead the design, implementation, and maintenance of real\-world AI capabilities (e.g., RAG systems, vector search, LLM integrations, and autonomous agents) directly into our customer\-facing product.
* **AI\-Augmented Development:** Leverage modern AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate delivery cycles while maintaining code integrity.
* **Collaborative Innovation:** Work closely with product managers, designers, and other engineers to translate user needs into innovative features and improvements.
* **Quality \& Security Governance:** Optimize application performance, ensure security and reliability, and conduct thorough code reviews to maintain high code quality.
* **Process Evolution:** Identify and resolve technical challenges, propose solutions, and contribute to the continuous improvement of our development processes.
* **Future\-Proofing:** Stay up to date with industry trends, specifically LLM integrations and automated testing advancements to evaluate and adopt emerging technologies that can enhance our platform’s capabilities.
* **Technical Mentorship**: Guide the team in best practices for modern engineering, from sophisticated TypeScript typing to efficient AI\-prompting for complex refactors.

 **Qualifications**

* **5\+ years of software engineering** experience building scalable, enterprise\-grade applications.
* **Startup/Scale\-Up Background:** Experience navigating fast\-paced software startup environments where shipping and iterating quickly is essential.
* **Production AI Experience:** Proven track record of shipping and operating real\-world AI features in a live product (e.g., RAG, LLM integrations, vector search, or AI agents) not just using AI coding tools.
* **Full\-Stack Proficiency:** Strong expertise in JavaScript/TypeScript environments, specifically the MEAN stack (MongoDB, Express, Angular, Node.js).
* **Modern Tooling \& Testing:** Fluent with AI\-assisted coding tools (Cursor, Copilot), automated testing (Jest, Cypress, Playwright), CI/CD, and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure, Docker).

 **Nice to Have Skills:**

* **Databases \& Vector Search:** Solid relational/NoSQL foundation alongside experience with vector search (e.g., MongoDB Atlas Vector Search) or search indexing.
* **Security \& Communication:** Security\-first mindset for handling sensitive corporate data and the ability to explain technical/AI trade\-offs to non\-technical partners.

 **Location**


We have embraced a distributed model of working to reach the best talent in the world. While some roles may require proximity to our Toronto, Calgary and Vancouver offices, roles based outside our office locations can be remote in Canada. Please only apply if you are able to live and work full\-time in Canada. **\#LI\-Remote**

 **Our Culture**


Our company thrives in a fast\-paced startup environment where every team member plays a critical role in driving success.

**Outcome Driven:** We focus on setting ambitious goals and achieving measurable results.

**Wide Responsibility:** Our team is empowered to take ownership from problem identification to implementation.

**Learning Mindset:** We embrace curiosity and reject the status quo.

**Strategic Speed:** We make fast, effective decisions and embrace a bias for action.

 **Benefits at Athennian**


We’re a remote\-first company built on trust, autonomy, and accountability.

**Work\-Life Balance:** Minimum of 3 weeks vacation, 5 sick days, and 6 personal/flex days, plus a company\-wide winter holiday shutdown.

**Comprehensive Coverage:** Health, dental, and vision, long\-term disability, and a Health Spending Account (HSA).

**Family Support:** Flexible parental leave benefits, including top\-ups.

**Remote Setup:** A dedicated work\-from\-home allowance to get you set up for success.

 **The pay range for this role is:**  

90,000 \- 130,000 CAD per year(Remote (Canada))

jobs.title: Lead, Software Engineer
jobs.description:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.


We are looking for an experienced, adaptable Software Engineer to join the Securities Finance and Collateral Management (SFCM) engineering team at Broadridge. In this hands\-on role, you will build and maintain high\-performance financial systems, strengthen test automation, and provide technical leadership on large\-scale projects from design through delivery. You will work across engineering and quality assurance, balancing reliability, security, performance, and cost while helping the team explore better ways to solve complex problems.

 **Key responsibilities**

* Design, develop, document, and maintain core SFCM Platform components, writing clean, efficient, reliable code as part of an agile squad.
* Provide technical leadership throughout the software development life cycle, guiding implementation, design updates, and the resolution of complex technical challenges.
* Evaluate architectural options, frameworks, infrastructure, and third\-party tools; make technology recommendations that account for scalability, security, performance, long\-term maintainability, and cost versus benefit.
* Build and improve automated integration tests, champion test\-driven development (TDD) and behavior\-driven development (BDD), and help deliver resilient software.
* Establish and promote coding standards, tooling guidelines, and secure development practices. Support compliance with enterprise and regulatory security requirements throughout the SDLC.
* Review code and critical designs, mentor developers, and contribute to technical discussions that raise engineering standards across the team.
* Translate business requirements into practical technical plans, working closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, QA teams, engineering colleagues, and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Communicate designs through clear documentation, including diagrams, flowcharts, and other appropriate artifacts. Help manage technical risks, delivery timelines, and budget considerations.
* Experiment thoughtfully with new approaches and technologies, using evidence to improve the platform and its development practices.

 **Skills and Experience**

  

We are looking for a self\-starter with a growth mindset and experience in a strong combination of the following areas:

* 10\+ years of professional software development experience, including technical leadership on large\-scale projects from inception through delivery.
* Experience working in agile teams and collaborating effectively with Product Owners, Business Analysts, QA teams, and business stakeholders.
* Proficiency in one or more of the following:
	+ Java 17/21 and Spring Boot or the Spring Framework
	+ Oracle PL/SQL
	+ JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and CSS
	+ REST API design and integration
* Deep knowledge of designing scalable, resilient, and maintainable systems using microservices, event\-driven design, and layered architectures. Experience designing asynchronous publish\-subscribe systems, message streaming with Kafka, and event sourcing.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP; containerization with Docker and Kubernetes; and serverless computing.
* Understanding of relational SQL and NoSQL databases, caching layers, and data partitioning strategies.
* Mastery of SOLID and domain\-driven design (DDD) principles, alongside established software design patterns.
* Sound judgment in software design and technology selection, with attention to performance optimization, security, maintainability, and cost.
* Familiarity with automation and testing tools such as Selenium, Playwright, JMeter, and Cucumber.
* Responsible, safe, and productive use of AI and agentic development tools.

 **Additional skills**

* Experience with C, C\#, or WPF.

 **Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

 **Other Requirements**

* Occasional overtime hours will be required on evenings/weekends for support

 **Recruitment Process**


Throughout your application process, you may be asked to contact us virtually or in\-person. Our recruiters will explain how hybrid interviews will be held throughout the recruitment process, and they will be able to answer any questions you might have.  



  

**Compensation**

**Salary Range:** CAD $110,000 \- $160,000\. Compensation may vary depending on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience, and location

 **AI Disclosure**


No AI or automated tools are used in the screening or assessment of applicants for this role.  



  

**Vacancy Disclosure**


This posting is for an existing and currently open position within Broadridge.  



  

**Background Check Process**


Broadridge requires employees to complete a background check that is completed by one of our service providers. We use this service to complete the following checks:

* Employment verification
* Education verification
* Credit inquiry
* Canadian criminal record check

 **Workplace Flexibility**


We are committed to supporting flexible work arrangements, investing in technology or other resources to enable you to work from home effectively, wherever possible. At this time this is a hybrid role, and therefore you should have a basic home office set up, high\-speed internet, and the ability to work without distractions during core business hours.

  

**Accessibility \& Accommodation**
